title: Widget "Network Speed": Several Display Styles do not show graphical changes in current down- and upload rates
line: The Network Speed widget's Horizontal Bars, Bar Chart and Color Grid styles now show the current rates instead of empty, full or fixed bars.
explanation: Rate sensors (network download/upload, disk read/write) have no fixed range, so they report a minimum and maximum of 0. With automatic range, Horizontal Bars used 0..0 and stayed empty; Color Grid divided by 0 and always used full color; Bar Chart's automatic range in Kirigami Charts takes the model's minimum/maximum when it has them, so the axis was 0..0 and every bar was drawn full. The change makes the three faces scale to the highest value seen so far when a sensor has no range (Bar Chart: one shared axis over all its sensors, summed when stacked); sensors with a real range and manual ranges behave as before.

commits.message:
faces: scale bars to the highest value seen for sensors without a range

Rate sensors like network speeds have a maximum of 0, so with automatic
range Horizontal Bars stayed empty, Bar Chart drew full bars and Color
Grid used full color. Scale them to the highest value seen instead.

BUG: 505409

patches.diff:
From 7ffa14f3d6499af37b0b4332967888685f4e8d13 Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: =?UTF-8?q?Niccol=C3=B2=20Venerandi?= <niccolo@venerandi.com>
Date: Sat, 21 Nov 2026 10:31:05 +0100
Subject: [PATCH] faces: scale bars to the highest value seen for sensors
 without a range

Rate sensors like network speeds have a maximum of 0, so with automatic
range Horizontal Bars stayed empty, Bar Chart drew full bars and Color
Grid used full color. Scale them to the highest value seen instead.

BUG: 505409
---
 .../barchart/contents/ui/BarChart.qml         | 21 ++++++++++++++++---
 .../colorgrid/contents/ui/SensorRect.qml      | 16 +++++++++++++-
 .../horizontalbars/contents/ui/Bar.qml        | 13 +++++++++++-
 3 files changed, 45 insertions(+), 5 deletions(-)

diff --git a/faces/facepackages/barchart/contents/ui/BarChart.qml b/faces/facepackages/barchart/contents/ui/BarChart.qml
index 6fc1ae49..0d98e738 100644
--- a/faces/facepackages/barchart/contents/ui/BarChart.qml
+++ b/faces/facepackages/barchart/contents/ui/BarChart.qml
@@ -41,10 +41,13 @@ Charts.BarChart {
     readonly property real rangeToY: controller.faceConfiguration.rangeTo *
                                      controller.faceConfiguration.rangeToMultiplier
 
+    // Sensors without a fixed range (like rates) report a maximum of 0
+    readonly property bool observedRange: controller.faceConfiguration.rangeAuto && sensorsModel.maximum <= sensorsModel.minimum
+
     yRange {
-        from: chart.rangeFromY
-        to: chart.rangeToY
-        automatic: controller.faceConfiguration.rangeAuto
+        from: chart.observedRange ? sensorsModel.minimum : chart.rangeFromY
+        to: chart.observedRange ? sensorsModel.observedMaximum : chart.rangeToY
+        automatic: controller.faceConfiguration.rangeAuto && !chart.observedRange
     }
 
     Sensors.SensorDataModel {
@@ -54,6 +57,18 @@ Charts.BarChart {
         sensorLabels: root.controller.sensorLabels
 
         property int unit: (sensorsModel.ready && sensorsModel.headerData(0, Qt.Horizontal, Sensors.SensorDataModel.Unit)) ?? Formatter.Units.UnitInvalid
+
+        property real observedMaximum: 0
+
+        onSensorsChanged: observedMaximum = 0
+        onDataChanged: {
+            let maximum = 0
+            for (let i = 0; i < sensorsModel.columnCount(); ++i) {
+                const value = sensorsModel.data(sensorsModel.index(0, i), Sensors.SensorDataModel.Value) ?? 0
+                maximum = chart.stacked ? maximum + value : Math.max(maximum, value)
+            }
+            observedMaximum = Math.max(observedMaximum, maximum)
+        }
     }
 
     Instantiator {
diff --git a/faces/facepackages/colorgrid/contents/ui/SensorRect.qml b/faces/facepackages/colorgrid/contents/ui/SensorRect.qml
index 1dd00313..a18c1cda 100644
--- a/faces/facepackages/colorgrid/contents/ui/SensorRect.qml
+++ b/faces/facepackages/colorgrid/contents/ui/SensorRect.qml
@@ -19,12 +19,26 @@ Rectangle {
     property alias text: label.text
     property color sensorColor
 
+    // Sensors without a fixed range (like rates) report a maximum of 0
+    property real observedMaximum: 0
+
+    Connections {
+        target: rect.sensor
+        function onValueChanged() {
+            rect.observedMaximum = Math.max(rect.observedMaximum, rect.sensor.value)
+        }
+    }
+    onSensorChanged: observedMaximum = 0
+
     color: Kirigami.ColorUtils.linearInterpolation(Kirigami.Theme.backgroundColor, Kirigami.Theme.textColor, 0.1)
 
     Rectangle {
         anchors.fill: parent
         color: rect.sensorColor
-        opacity: (rect.sensor.value / rect.sensor.maximum)
+        opacity: {
+            const maximum = rect.sensor.maximum > rect.sensor.minimum ? rect.sensor.maximum : rect.observedMaximum
+            return maximum > 0 ? rect.sensor.value / maximum : 0
+        }
     }
 
     Label {
diff --git a/faces/facepackages/horizontalbars/contents/ui/Bar.qml b/faces/facepackages/horizontalbars/contents/ui/Bar.qml
index d49ebd58..12aac55b 100644
--- a/faces/facepackages/horizontalbars/contents/ui/Bar.qml
+++ b/faces/facepackages/horizontalbars/contents/ui/Bar.qml
@@ -30,9 +30,20 @@ ProgressBar {
     readonly property real rangeFrom: controller.faceConfiguration.rangeFrom * controller.faceConfiguration.rangeFromMultiplier
     readonly property real rangeTo: controller.faceConfiguration.rangeTo * controller.faceConfiguration.rangeToMultiplier
 
+    // Sensors without a fixed range (like rates) report a maximum of 0
+    property real observedMaximum: 0
+
     value: sensor?.value ?? 0
     from: controller.faceConfiguration.rangeAuto ? sensor.minimum : rangeFrom
-    to: controller.faceConfiguration.rangeAuto ? sensor.maximum : rangeTo
+    to: controller.faceConfiguration.rangeAuto ? (sensor.maximum > sensor.minimum ? sensor.maximum : observedMaximum) : rangeTo
+
+    Connections {
+        target: bar.sensor
+        function onValueChanged() {
+            bar.observedMaximum = Math.max(bar.observedMaximum, bar.sensor.value)
+        }
+    }
+    onSensorChanged: observedMaximum = 0
 
     topPadding: topInset
     bottomPadding: bottomInset
-- 
2.53.0

media.caption: Master, three moments of changing disk load (rate sensors, same as network speed): Horizontal Bars stay empty, Bar Chart bars are full with every axis label 0 B/s, Color Grid is fully colored even at 8 KiB/s. Line chart on the right for reference.
With the fix, same load: the bars, bar heights and color strength follow the rates and the Bar Chart axis shows real values.
The sweep tester's earlier capture on master (kdetest3): empty Horizontal Bars and full Bar Chart bars at 10.2 MiB/s vs 0 B/s.

review.text: The cause is right (rate sensors report a 0..0 range, so auto range has nothing to scale to) and before/after media show bars that now move. But the chosen scale is the highest value ever seen and never shrinks: the third after frame already shows Horizontal Bars and Color Grid almost empty at 200 KiB/s after one 400 MiB/s burst, which recreates the reported 'shows no changes' after any peak. The same observed-maximum logic is also copy-pasted into three faces.
changes: Use a peak that decays or covers a recent window (e.g. the same history length the line chart uses) instead of an all-time maximum.
Put the observed-range logic in one shared place (e.g. a helper in libksysguard's faces/sensors code) instead of duplicating it in Bar.qml, SensorRect.qml and BarChart.qml.
